name: Warrior Graveyard xNudge®

features.name: Warrior Attack
features.description: Matching warriors nudge to cover a reel.

review:
Warrior Graveyard xNudge is a 6x3 fantasy slot with three-row Tombstone Wilds on reels 2 to 5. They always nudge into view, and their multipliers add up when they share a win.

Three or more of the same warrior trigger Warrior Attack, nudging that symbol to cover the reel. Three, four or five scatters award 8, 10 or 12 Graveyard Spins. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 9,797x cap.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
